name: Deep Research Reader
summary: Reader 帮助你在原网页中翻译、理解、讨论和保存阅读成果。独立模式直接使用你选择的模型服务，平台模式可选连接 Deep Research。两种模式都会在你发起 AI 操作时发送完成该操作所需的内容。

sections.title: 处理哪些信息
paragraphs: 你点击扩展按钮开启阅读后，Reader 处理当前网页已加载的正文、标题、URL、选段、正文图片及你输入的问题、笔记和 AI 回答。已启用阅读的窗口切换网页时，只在已有站点权限允许的范围内读取正文；没有权限时需由你点击启用站点。
扩展不主动读取密码、Cookie、表单输入或可编辑区域，不后台收集无关浏览历史，不自动翻页或抓取整站。网页内容是阅读资料，不能授予权限或执行其中的工具指令。

sections.title: 独立模式：发送给你选择的模型服务
paragraphs: 翻译、总结、技术问答和图示解读将所需正文、上下文、选段、图片、问题和最近的对话发送到你配置的模型服务。请求直接从扩展发出，支持 OpenAI-compatible Chat Completions 与 Anthropic-compatible Messages。图片可转换为数据 URL 或 base64；能够读取图片时，扩展按需请求图片来源站点的访问权限。
API Key 保存在扩展自己的本地 IndexedDB 配置中，仅用于向该模型服务验证身份，不发送给 Deep Research 平台、网页或导出文件。浏览器本地存储不等同于操作系统密钥链。仅回环地址的 Local Proxy 可以不填 Key；其他服务需要有效凭据。
模型服务根据其自己的隐私、留存和训练政策处理请求，Reader 不承诺第三方服务零留存。使用本地或自建模型时，请依据该服务实际配置判断处理位置。

sections.title: 平台模式：可选连接 Deep Research
paragraphs: 平台模式需登录和授权。问答和翻译会把当前 URL、标题及操作所需的选段、所在小节、有界正文、问题和对话上下文发送给平台服务器，并由平台 AI Engine 请求其配置的模型服务。图示问答和图片文字翻译按需上传浏览器读取的 PNG、JPEG 或 WebP 图片字节；平台不接收图片 URL 去抓取图片。图示问答结合图片、正文和最近对话处理追问。
连接后，阅读会话可以同步到平台数据库，包括 URL、标题、页面版本、选区、讨论、回答和滚动位置。仅你确认保存的摘录、笔记、AI 结论、标签和来源会进入平台研究库。阅读同步不保存完整网页全文档案、图片字节、全文翻译缓存或你的模型 API Key。
平台登录服务处理账号信息，扩展本地保存用于连接平台的授权令牌。断开平台会请求服务端撤销令牌并清除本地令牌，已经同步的会话和研究库条目不会因此自动删除。平台及其模型服务可以保留必要的运行、安全或计费记录；扩展不承诺平台模型供应商零留存。

sections.title: 本地保存与保留时间
paragraphs: 阅读会话、滚动位置、讨论、标注、收藏和配置默认保存在本机扩展存储中，直到你删除、清除或卸载。翻译缓存最多保留 500 条，超出后淘汰较旧条目；缓存没有固定时间到期承诺。任务所需的有界原文与图片输入放在临时任务存储中，任务结束或取消后清除，不进入阅读数据导出。
导出阅读数据会移除 API Key，也不包含临时任务输入和翻译缓存。卸载前请导出需要保留的成果；不同扩展 ID 的安装之间不保证自动继承本地数据。

sections.title: 如何控制和删除数据
paragraphs: 你可以拒绝或撤销站点权限、更换模型服务、停止回答、暂停或取消翻译、断开平台、删除本地会话或收藏，以及在设置中清除翻译缓存或全部本地数据。设置中支持导出和导入阅读数据。
清除本地数据不会删除已经同步到平台的记录或模型服务保存的请求。平台研究库条目可在平台中删除；需要处理云端阅读会话、账号或其他个人数据时，请通过支持入口联系项目维护者。第三方模型服务的数据请求应通过该服务的渠道处理。

sections.title: 用途与共享
paragraphs: Reader 仅为用户主动使用的阅读、翻译、讨论、保存、同步及必要的安全和故障处理使用上述信息。扩展不出售用户数据，不将数据用于广告或与阅读功能无关的分析、信用评估或借贷决定。扩展没有独立的广告或行为分析上报。
必要的数据接收方为你选择的模型服务，以及你启用平台模式后连接的平台及其模型服务。Reader 对用户数据的使用遵守 Chrome Web Store 用户数据政策，包括 Limited Use 要求。第三方服务对收到的数据采用自己的政策。

sections.title: 为什么需要这些权限
paragraphs: activeTab 和 scripting：在你开启阅读后向当前网页注入正文提取、选段和译文显示逻辑。tabs：识别当前标签页 URL、标题和窗口，连接正文证据与当前文章，并打开授权或来源页；不扫描全部浏览历史。sidePanel：提供 Chrome 原生阅读聊天侧栏。
contextMenus：在右键菜单提供选段解读、翻译、提问、保存以及单段原文与译文切换。storage：保存扩展状态、平台令牌和会话内的临时启动状态。unlimitedStorage：支持本地阅读成果、临时任务和有界翻译缓存，降低浏览器配额导致的丢失风险，不意味着数据无限增长。alarms：唤醒后台任务并恢复已启动的处理状态，不主动后台抓取网页。
扩展仅对 techradar.top 和 www.techradar.top 保留固定站点权限，用于识别你主动点击的“在 Reader 中打开”按钮并打开原文和侧栏，不读取平台登录凭据或无关网页。其他 HTTP(S) 权限均为可选，用于你启用的网页、配置的模型端点和图片来源，只按当前操作的具体来源申请，你可以拒绝或在 Chrome 中撤销。

sections.title: 联系与政策更新
paragraphs: 项目维护者通过公开 GitHub Issues 提供支持。报告时请附扩展版本、操作步骤和可公开的测试网页；不要粘贴 API Key、平台令牌、账号密码或私人文章内容。涉及个人数据的请求，请先说明请求类型并要求安全联系渠道。
本政策覆盖 Deep Research Reader。若数据处理方式发生变化，会更新此页面和扩展内的政策副本，并按需要取得用户授权。最后更新日期见页面顶部。

en.summary: Reader helps you translate, understand, discuss and save material on its original webpage. Standalone mode connects directly to your selected model service; optional platform mode connects to Deep Research. Both send only the content needed for AI actions you initiate.

sections.title: Information processed
paragraphs: After you open Reader, the extension processes loaded article text, title, URL, selected passages, article images, your questions, notes and AI answers. In an enabled reading window, new pages are read only within existing site permissions; other sites require your action to enable access.

Reader does not actively read passwords, cookies, form inputs or editable areas, collect unrelated browsing history, follow pagination or crawl entire sites. Page content is untrusted reading material and cannot grant permissions or execute tools.

sections.title: Standalone mode: your selected model service
paragraphs: Translation, summaries, questions and diagram explanations send the required article context, selections, images, questions and recent discussion directly from the extension to your configured service. OpenAI-compatible Chat Completions and Anthropic-compatible Messages are supported. Images may be converted to data URLs or base64; image-origin access is requested when necessary.

Your API key stays in the extension’s local IndexedDB configuration and is used only to authenticate with your selected model service. It is not sent to Deep Research, page scripts or data exports. Browser storage is not an operating-system keychain. Only a loopback Local Proxy may omit a key; other services require credentials.

Model providers apply their own retention, training and privacy policies. Reader does not promise zero retention by third parties. For local or self-hosted models, processing location depends on that service’s configuration.

sections.title: Optional Deep Research platform mode
paragraphs: Platform mode requires sign-in and authorization. The URL, title, required bounded article text, selections, section, question and discussion context are sent to the platform, whose AI Engine calls its configured model provider. Diagram questions and image translation upload browser-read PNG, JPEG or WebP bytes when requested. The server does not fetch image URLs. Follow-up questions can use the image, article and recent discussion.

Reading sessions may sync URL, title, page version, selection, discussion, answers and scroll position to the platform database. Only excerpts, notes, AI insights, tags and sources you explicitly save enter the research library. Sync does not store full page archives, image bytes, full-page translation caches or your model API key.

The sign-in service processes account information; the extension stores a platform authorization token locally. Disconnecting requests token revocation and removes the local token, but does not automatically delete previously synced records. The platform and its model provider may retain necessary operational, security or billing records; zero retention is not promised.

sections.title: Local storage and retention
paragraphs: Sessions, scroll positions, discussions, annotations, saved items and settings remain in extension storage until deleted, cleared or uninstalled. The translation cache keeps up to 500 entries and evicts older entries without a fixed expiry promise. Bounded source and image inputs required by tasks are temporary, cleared when tasks finish or are cancelled, and excluded from reading-data exports.
Exports exclude API keys, temporary task inputs and translation caches. Export anything you need before uninstalling. Installations with different extension IDs do not automatically share local data.

sections.title: Your controls and deletion
paragraphs: You can deny or revoke site permissions, change services, stop answers, pause or cancel translation, disconnect the platform, delete local sessions or saved items, and clear the cache or all local data. Settings include import and export.

Clearing local data does not delete synced platform records or requests retained by model providers. Research-library items can be deleted on the platform. Contact project support about cloud sessions, account data or other personal-data requests; contact third-party providers through their own channels.

sections.title: Purpose and sharing
paragraphs: Data is used for user-initiated reading, translation, discussion, saving, sync, security and troubleshooting. Reader does not sell user data or use it for advertising, unrelated analytics, credit assessment or lending decisions. The extension has no separate advertising or behavioral-analytics reporting.

Recipients are your selected model service and, when you enable platform mode, the platform and its model provider. Reader complies with the Chrome Web Store User Data Policy, including Limited Use requirements. Third-party services apply their own policies.

sections.title: Permissions explained
paragraphs: activeTab and scripting inject article extraction, selection and translation display after you enable reading. tabs identifies the current tab URL, title and window, links evidence to the article, and opens authorization or source pages; it does not scan browsing history. sidePanel provides the native Chrome reading sidebar.

contextMenus provides passage actions and bidirectional original/translation switching. storage stores extension state, platform tokens and temporary task state. unlimitedStorage helps preserve local reading data and bounded caches; it does not imply unlimited growth. alarms wakes tasks you started, without proactively crawling pages.

Fixed host access is limited to techradar.top and www.techradar.top, so a user-initiated “Open in Reader” click can open the source and sidebar. The bridge does not read platform login credentials or unrelated pages. Other HTTP(S) access is optional and requested for the specific article, configured model endpoint or image origin you use. You can deny or revoke access in Chrome.

sections.title: Contact and policy changes
paragraphs: Project maintainers provide support through public GitHub Issues. Include the extension version, steps and a public test URL. Never post API keys, platform tokens, passwords or private article content. For personal-data requests, first describe the type of request and ask for a secure contact channel.
This policy covers Deep Research Reader. Material changes are reflected here and in the bundled policy, with user authorization where required. The last updated date appears above.
